
CREATE-PREFIX
Register a new work unit prefix for organizing work by component or area

WHEN TO USE
  Use when starting work on a new component or area that needs its own work unit namespace.

USAGE
  fspec create-prefix <prefix> <description>

ARGUMENTS
  <prefix> (required)
    Prefix code (e.g., AUTH, UI, API) - uppercase, short
  <description> (required)
    Description of what this prefix represents

OPTIONS
  No options available

EXAMPLES
  1. Register new prefix
  $ fspec create-prefix AUTH "Authentication features"
  ✓ Created prefix AUTH
  Description: Authentication features

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec list-prefixes
  fspec update-prefix
  fspec create-story
  fspec create-bug
  fspec create-task

NOTES
  • Prefix must be uppercase
  • Required before creating work units with that prefix
